title: ネイチャ・イン・メジロ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan agree to let Nice Nature spend a day with them to learn the secret of their strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she accompanies them during their training, she finds that their strength comes from their mutual respect and competition with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature realizes that the key to improving is to observe the other racers around her and use that as motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Takarazuka Kinen just up ahead, her desire to beat the two Mejiro racers grows stronger.
